work.description: DCLXI: complete Jamdiu ad Nos body, revocation and regulated new concession, transumpt clause and datum LF4287–4292. The protocol and recipient list belong to this act; XML leaves37–38 follow L/R with a running header only at LF4249. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
